<a2ui>
surface("status-list")
filter = segmented_control([{label: "All", value: "all"}, {label: "Active", value: "active"}, {label: "Pending", value: "pending"}, {label: "Blocked", value: "blocked"}, {label: "Done", value: "done"}], "all", "status_filter")
intro = heading("Work Items")
note = body("Eight items, each with a status and a one-line detail. Use the control to filter by status.")
items = entity_list([{name: "Migrate billing database", subtitle: "Cutover rehearsal scheduled for Thursday", status: "Active"}, {name: "Redesign onboarding flow", subtitle: "Waiting on final copy from marketing", status: "Pending"}, {name: "Upgrade API gateway", subtitle: "Rollout paused by failed health checks", status: "Blocked"}, {name: "Publish Q3 report", subtitle: "Shared with leadership on Monday", status: "Done"}, {name: "Audit access permissions", subtitle: "12 of 40 service accounts reviewed", status: "Active"}, {name: "Vendor security review", subtitle: "Questionnaire sent, awaiting response", status: "Pending"}, {name: "Fix mobile checkout bug", subtitle: "Blocked on payment provider sandbox access", status: "Blocked"}, {name: "Retire legacy dashboard", subtitle: "Decommissioned and archived last week", status: "Done"}])
root = columns(2, "2rem", "top", [{blocks: [intro, note, filter]}, {blocks: [items]}])
</a2ui>

The filter control is display-only, because the segmented control in this catalog has no way to trigger an action or change what the list shows. Choosing a status won't hide any of the eight items. I split the layout into two columns (filter on the left, list on the right) because the `columns` component needs at least two columns and is the only layout container available.
